MOTION TO WAIVE FURTHER READING OF RESOLUTIONS AND ORDINANCES AFTER

4.  ANNOUNCEMENT OF WITHDRAWN, DEFERRED, AND/OR SUPPLEMENTAL ITEMS

5.  COUNCIL COMMITTEE MEETINGS AND ANNOUNCEMENTS

6.  COMMUNITY MATTERS

  6A. PROCLAMATION declaring October 6, 2024 through October 12, 2024 as Fire
  Prevention Week in the City of Torrance.
  6A - STAFF REPORT

  6B. Recognition of Torrance South High Students for Community Outreach Program.

7.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS #1 (Limited up to a 15-minute period) This portion of the
  meeting is reserved for comments on items that are not on the agenda. Under the
  Ralph M. Brown Act, City Council cannot act on items raised during public comment,
  but may respond briefly to statements made or questions posed; request clarification;
  or refer the item to staff. Speakers under Orals are limited to either Oral
  Communications #1 or Oral Communications #2 and no longer than 1 minute per
  speaker. Time starts when you step up to the microphone. If presenting handout
  material to Council, please provide 11 copies to the City Clerk before speaking.
  Handouts will be distributed while you speak.
  7A-SUPPLEMENTAL

8.  CONSENT CALENDAR
  Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion and one
  vote. There will be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed by
  a Councilmember from the Consent Calendar and considered separately..

  8A. City Clerk – Approve City Council Minutes. Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the City Clerk that City Council approve the City Council minutes of
  September 10, 2024.

  8B. General Services and Public Works – Authorize Purchase Order for One (1)
  Reclaimer/Stabilizer as Cooperative Purchase. Expenditure: $290,922.50(Non-
  General Fund).
  Recommendation of the General Services Director and Public Works Director that City
   Council authorize a purchase order with Asphalt Zipper of Pleasant Grove, UT as a
  cooperative purchase with Houston-Galveston Area Council (H-GAC), in the amount of
  $290,922.50, including sales tax, for one (1) Reclaimer/Stabilizer.
  8B - STAFF REPORT

  8C. Civil Service Commission and Human Resources – Approve Proposed Class
  Specification for Information Technology Manager – Public Safety. Expenditure:
  None.
  Recommendation of the Civil Service Commission and Human Resources Director that City
  Council approve the proposed class specification for the Information Technology Manager –
  Public Safety.
  8C - STAFF REPORT

9.  HEARINGS – None Scheduled

10.  ADMINISTRATIVE MATTERS

  10A. City Manager – Adopt Categorical Exemption Under California Environmental
  Quality Act (CEQA) Section 15301, Approve New Lease Agreement Between City
  and Torrance Historical Society for City-Owned Building Located at 1345 Post
  Avenue and Adopt RESOLUTION Determining Portion of Certain City-Owned
  Property Not Required For City Purposes and that Leasing the Property is in the
  Public Interest. Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the City Manager that City Council:
  1) Adopt a California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Categorical Exemption Pursuant
  to Guideline Section 15301 (Existing Facilities); and
  2) Approve a new lease agreement between City and Torrance Historical Society for City-
  owned building located at 1345 Post Avenue for an initial term of twenty (20) years,
  commencing October 15, 2024 and ending on October 14, 2044; and
  3) Adopt RESOLUTION determining portion of City owned property at 1345 Post Avenue
  is not required for City purposes and that leasing the property is in the public interest.
  10A - STAFF REPORT
  10A - SUPPLEMENTAL

  10B. City Manager – Determine City Council Dark Nights. Expenditure: None.
  Recommendation of the City Manager that City Council declare the following Tuesdaysas
  City Council Dark Nights from January 1, 2025 through June 30, 2025: January 7, January
  21, February 4, February 18, March 4, March 18, April 1, April 15, April 29, May 13, May 27,
  June 10, and June 24.
  10B - STAFF REPORT

  10C. Public Works – Appropriate Funds and Approve Contract Services Agreement for
  Design-Build of a Hydrogen Sulfide Gas Scrubber System at the North Torrance
  Well Field. Expenditure: $1,242,583.10 (Non-General Fund).
  Recommendation of the Public Works Director that City Council:
  1) Appropriate $1,242,583.10 from the Water Enterprise Fund Balance to the North
  Torrance Well Field Project (I-108); and
  2) Approve a contract services agreement with Pacific Hydrotech Corporation of Perris,
  CA as a special opportunity purchase, for a not-to-exceed amount of $1,129,621, and
  authorize a 10% contingency of $112,962.10, for a total not-to-exceed amount of
  $1,242,583.10, to provide design, permitting, and procurement services and install a
  hydrogen sulfide (H2S) gas scrubber system at the North Torrance Well Field for a two-
  year period beginning October 8, 2024, and ending October 7, 2026.
  10C - STAFF REPORT

11.  AGENCY AGENDAS – None Scheduled

12.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS #2 (Limited up to a 15-minute period) Council Order –
  Kalani, Lewis, Mattucci, Sheikh, Gerson, Kaji , Mayor Chen This portion of the
  meeting is reserved for comments on items not on the agenda. Under the Ralph M.
  Brown Act, City Council cannot act on items raised during public comment, but may
  respond briefly to statements made or questions posed; request clarification; or refer
  the item to staff. Speakers under Orals are limited to either Oral Communications #1
   or Oral Communications #2 and no longer than 1 minute per speaker. Time starts
  when you step up to the microphone. If presenting handout material to Council,
  please provide 11 copies to the City Clerk before speaking. Handouts will be
  distributed while you speak.

14.  ADJOURNMENT

  14A. Adjournment of City Council meeting to Tuesday, October 15, 2024, at 5:00 p.m.
  for closed session in the LeRoy J. Jackson Council Chamber.
  14A - STAFF REPORT
